amendments.text: (a) The suitability and durability of materials used in the structure must be-- (1) Established by experience or tests; and (2) Meet approved specifications that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data. (b) Workmanship must be of a high standard.

[(a) The suitability and durability of materials used for parts, the failure of which could adversely affect safety, must be--] (1) Established by experience or tests; and (2) Meet approved specifications that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data.
